timer: proc.time elapsed/user.self/sys.self; system.time wraps an explicit repeated-call loop
concurrent_workload: Coordinator reported four principal R simulation workers active. This benchmark adds one sequential R process; no controlled idle-machine comparison was made.
warmup: One call per method and dataset before timing; cached weights/grid and R JIT are warm.

method_scope.KDE-R: kernel_estimate(x), including the local densities, algebraic variance and empirical influence-function diagnostic
method_scope.GLD-TM: fit_tm(x, precomputed pdQ parameters) plus gld_estimate; excludes the precomputed pdQ starting fit
method_scope.Bootstrap399: 399 new n-out-of-n resample-index rows, unnormalised midpoint MADs, percentile endpoints and resample variance

resume_policy: Reuse only measured batches at least 0.1 seconds with the same core-source and fixture hashes; extend shorter batches.
